summary: Checks whether one grid range lies entirely within another.
description: Containment is inclusive: a range contains itself. An absent bound on the outer range means it is open in that direction and so contains anything on that axis, which is how a whole column or a whole sheet is expressed.
This is the check to run before writing into a range a user chose, so that a write cannot spill outside the area the script owns.

params.range2: The range it is compared against.

returns: `true` when the first range lies inside the second.

examples.title: Checking containment
